title: zaentrum library — shared definitions
description: Types shared by work, version, source and package documents. A library on storage is the source of truth; databases are caches built from it.

uuid.description: Lower-case RFC 4122 UUID. Identity never changes, so nothing keyed by it is ever renamed.

date.description: Full date, or year-month, or year when that is all that is known.

language.description: BCP 47. Normalised from ISO 639-2/B codes found in files (ger->de, fre->fr, chi->zh, dut->nl). The raw file code is kept alongside as languageRaw where it differs.

relPath.description: Path relative to the document's own directory. Never absolute, never escaping upward.

rev.description: Per-document revision, incremented by one on every write. Never a timestamp.

createdAt.description: When the object entered the library. For works this is 'date added' and orders 'recently added' rows, so it must survive every migration unchanged.

evidence.description: One observation supporting a derived conclusion. Kept so a conclusion can be re-examined without re-reading the file.

decision.description: A conclusion with its confidence and who reached it. A human decision always outranks an inferred one and is never overwritten by automation.

externalIds.description: Explicit, unambiguous keys. The legacy manifest used one polymorphic 'tmdbId' that meant the movie id on a movie and the SERIES id on an episode; that ambiguity is removed here.

tmdbTv.description: On a series, its own TV id. On an episode, the parent series' TV id.

file.description: e.g. art/poster.3d9c8f1ab20e77d5.jpg — content hash in the name makes the file immutable and cacheable forever.

sourceUrl.description: Where the image was fetched from, so the exact chosen image can be refetched even after the provider's default changes.

inherit.description: 'parent': an episode without its own image shows its series' image. Recorded, never materialised as a copy.

fixity.description: Proves a file is the same bytes after a move. qh1 is cheap and always present; sha256 of the whole file is filled in by a background job and is what a move is verified against.

qh1.description: sha256(first 64 KiB || last 64 KiB || uint64be(size)). Not a content hash.
